title: Ask anything about living and working in Switzerland
intro: Residence and work permits, registration and naturalisation, health insurance, losing a job and unemployment insurance, social insurance and the pension system, tax at source, driving licences and vehicles, customs when you move or order from abroad, the Zurich offices, and daily life in the City of Zurich: waste and recycling, parking, dogs, kindergarten, the tax return and the radio and TV fee. Federal rules, with the procedures of the Canton of Zurich and the City of Zurich.
note: Answers come from reviewed facts of official sources and cite them. Ask in English or German.
questions: When is the Road Traffic Office in Zurich open, and do I need an appointment?
I'm moving to the city of Zurich with my dog. What do I have to do for the dog?
When is the next organic waste collection in 8001?
I'm a Czech citizen and start working in Zurich next week. By when at the latest do I have to register?
I have had a B permit since March 2022 and work in Zurich. My 13-year-old son still lives in Pristina. Can he join me now?
I arrived in Zurich from Canada two months ago on a B permit and have no health insurance yet. Is it too late, and from when will I pay?
My premium is going up again. Can I switch insurer, and by when?
I got my notice this morning. My last working day is at the end of November. What do I have to do, and when?
I ordered a jacket from Germany for 180 francs. Do I have to pay anything when it arrives?
Ich habe eine B-Bewilligung, arbeite in Zürich und heirate nächsten Monat einen Schweizer. Werde ich weiterhin an der Quelle besteuert?
Ich wohne im Ausland und bin in der Schweiz krankenversichert. Wer ist für meine Prämienverbilligung zuständig?
